newsitem.title: USA: Alabama Power says to redeem some stock.
newsitem.headline: Alabama Power says to redeem some stock.

text.p: Alabama Power Co said on Friday that it would fully redeem its 5.96 percent, 6.88 percent and 7.60 percent series of preferred stock.

The redemption date for the 5.96 percent and 6.88 percent series of preferred stock will be June 3, the company said in a statement. The 5.96 percent preferred stock will be redeemed at a price of $103.37 per share, plus accrued dividends of $1.026, and the 6.88 percent preferred stock will be redeemed at a price of $102.90 per share, plus accrued dividends of $1.185, it said.
In addition, the 7.60 percent Class A preferred stock (Second 1992 Series) will be redeemed on July 2, at a price of $25.00 per share, plus accrued dividends of $0.005 per share, it said.
Alabama Power, a subsidiary of Southern Co, is an electric utility.
